ns2:section.sectionText: TV Prod: Good Morning Illini - On Air Perfomance Students who have successfully completed Jour 340 will learn advance skills to be on-air reporters for the Good Morning Illini show. Students will learn advance videography, editing and reporting skills. Class will also include on-camera/talent lab for Good Morning Illini's live broadcast on Friday's. Pre-requisites for this course are completion of Jour 340. May be taken concurrently with J445. This course meets with JOUR 199 (64995) and JOUR 460 (64206)
